# `senate_disclosure_reports`

**Senate transaction report observations**

One row per native filing UUID, retaining original and amended observations separately.

**Coverage.** Sampled. A declared calendar filing year from the public Senate eFD PTR search. Electronic reports are qualified; listed paper reports remain unsupported observations. Annual reports are outside this selection. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

**Data quality.** Parent matches use literal listing names and report dates and may be ambiguous. No amendment replacement semantics, person enrichment or paper/annual completeness is inferred.

- **Parquet file:** `senate_disclosure_reports.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filing_year` | `INTEGER` | Calendar year selected by the publisher submission-date search; transaction dates may be outside it. |
| `report_id` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher UUID from the filing URL; amendments have their own UUID. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Original public eFD report locator; using it may require the publisher agreement session. |
| `report_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of exact electronic report HTML. Null for unsupported paper observations. |
| `first_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal first-name cell from the search listing, with outer whitespace removed. |
| `last_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal last-name cell from the search listing, with outer whitespace removed. |
| `filer_label` | `VARCHAR` | Literal filer description from the listing; no bioguide or private identity enrichment. |
| `report_kind` | `VARCHAR` | electronic or paper, as stated by the native report URL. |
| `report_title` | `VARCHAR` | Complete literal listing title, including any amendment label. |
| `report_date` | `DATE` | Date in the report title, distinct from its submission date. |
| `submitted_date` | `DATE` | Date stated in the listing; electronic report filed date must agree. |
| `amendment_status` | `VARCHAR` | none, numbered or unnumbered, from the native title. |
| `amendment_number` | `INTEGER` | Number printed in an amendment title; null when absent. |
| `original_candidate_ids` | `VARCHAR[]` | Derived original electronic report candidates with the same literal first/last names and report date within this selection. Does not establish replacement or cumulative semantics. |
| `amendment_link_status` | `VARCHAR` | not_applicable, unique_candidate, ambiguous or unresolved. Candidate matching is derived and never collapses filings. |
| `parse_status` | `VARCHAR` | parsed for qualified electronic HTML; unsupported_paper for listed paper filings. Source failures prevent a completed build. |
| `filer_heading` | `VARCHAR` | Complete printed electronic-report filer heading; null for unparsed paper. |
| `filed_at_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Printed Filed date and time, without an inferred timezone. |
| `transaction_count` | `BIGINT` | Printed electronic report transaction count, reconciled with every table row; null for paper. |
| `search_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the original JSON search page that states this filing. |
| `search_start` | `BIGINT` | Zero-based publisher page offset. |
| `search_row` | `BIGINT` | One-based row position within the retained search page. |
| `raw_search_cells_json` | `VARCHAR` | All original search cells, including literal link HTML and untouched whitespace. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | Acquisition time of the electronic report original, distinct from the filed date; null for paper. |
